items.question: If the charges on a ride add up to less than the minimum trip fare, what does this service charge you?
items.fact: Charges below minimum fare: only the minimum fare is charged

items.question: Does this service always notify you when a Peak time surcharge applies to your ride?
items.gold: Yes, you will always be notified when it's Peak time.
items.fact: Peak time surcharge: riders always notified beforehand
